raw_html: [[Trap the Soul (enchantment)|Epic Trap the Soul]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]][[Trap the Soul (enchantment)|'''Epic Trap the Soul:''']] This equipment stores an overwhelming, merciless power deep within. When you strike an enemy with a melee or missile attack, this power occasionally comes to the surface, sucking out the life force of an enemy and imprisoning the essence of their body and soul in a gem.
